entries.2abcc15a87ee2f5e: This is a single segment engaged in the manufacture and sale of packaging materials (composite films and single films) and the purchase and sale of packaging materials (composite films, single films, containers, etc.). Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 is ¥18,775 million. Composite films are manufactured at the Fukuoka Plant (Ogori, Fukuoka Prefecture) of the head office, the consolidated subsidiary Hong Kong Packaging Equipment Center Co., Ltd. sells them in Hong Kong and China, and MARUTO（THAILAND）CO.,LTD. sells them in the Kingdom of Thailand.
entries.4603dda086b9d92c: Sales of products other than the above items, such as machinery for overseas markets. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥2,716 million (down 8.1% year on year).
entries.76b5f77cd09cd6cd: Purchases and sells packaging materials such as food trays and food containers. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥1,431 million (down 2.6% year on year), as orders from overseas supermarkets decreased.
entries.7e11937c5b5c6cd6: Customers such as food manufacturers and pharmaceutical manufacturers
entries.81bf79f04ad38aad: Manufactures and sells composite (laminated) films used for packaging food and pharmaceuticals. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥13,451 million (up 7.9% year on year), reflecting an increase in orders from existing domestic customers and the effect of price revisions.
entries.88f600b9bd97562e: A packaging materials manufacturer headquartered in Ogori City, Fukuoka Prefecture, that manufactures and sells packaging film for foods and pharmaceuticals.
entries.fb29e70350eb8ef0: Manufactures and sells single films such as polyethylene films. Sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥1,175 million (up 1.3% year on year), with increases in films for pharmaceutical and food packaging.
